blocks.text: CARMONA–The Manila Southwoods will be hosting the Philippine Open golf championship for the second straight year, and management of one of the most prestigious private clubs in the country is leaving no stones unturned and sparing no expense to make the 108th playing of Asia’s oldest national championship at the Masters course a special one. A little over P35 million will be spent to turn the Jack Nicklaus-designed gem into the best version of itself before the first drive is hit on Nov. 12 for the finale of the 2026 Asian Tour season, as the talented field will be challenged the […]... Keep on reading: Masters to be at its finest form come 108th Philippine Open
